title: Two AI companies reveal 'Earth-shattering' solutions to major maths problem | New Scientist
description: Anthropic and OpenAI reported proofs of the same maths problem on the same day – a step that could help solve the monumental conundrum known as P versus NP
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Severe eczema healed by novel immune-calming pill in clinical trial | New Scientist
description: An experimental drug has been found to be highly effective and safe for treating moderate to severe eczema in a clinical trial and has the advantage of being taken in pill form rather than injected
author: Alice Klein

title: Toddlers form complex memories but may then lose access to them | New Scientist
description: Few of us can remember events from our earliest years, but that might be because we lose the ability to recall memories - not because we didn't make them in the first place
author: Sascha Brodsky

title: The technology that could make government internet blackouts impossible | New Scientist
description: Direct-to-cell technology could one day provide a lifeline for getting around authoritarian regimes’ internet shutdowns, but international law and technical limitations are holding the technology back for now
author: Will McCurdy

title: Submarine finds world's deepest explosive volcanic activity in Mariana trench | New Scientist
description: A deep-sea robotic submarine has found evidence of explosive volcanic eruptions 6100 metres below sea level, surprising scientists who were only seeking geological samples
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: COP31 collapse has shattered the pretence of a global climate consensus | New Scientist
description: Climate progressive countries took the radical step of torpedoing a deal at the UN summit in Turkey amid outrage over obstructionist tactics from petrostates. What happens now?
author: Madeleine Cuff
